labels.unsafe: The content contains material from any listed category. Sex education and wellness content is not unsafe.
labels.safe: Content containing none of that material.

safety.instruction: Is the content unsafe? It is often not a request: judge what the text itself contains, not what answering it would involve. Unsafe categories: sexual content meant to arouse or to promote sexual services; hate based on a protected characteristic; promotion or glorification of violence, or celebration of suffering or humiliation; harassment likely to torment a real person or make harassment of them more likely; promotion, encouragement, or depiction of self-harm; sexual content involving a minor; hateful threats of violence or serious harm toward a protected group; or extremely graphic depictions of death, violence, or serious physical injury.
